basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old audio enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. I work as an environmental engineer and often spend my evenings diving deep into headphone mods and audio gear reviews. I enjoy exploring the intersection of technology and sustainability. When I'm not tinkering with headphones, you might find me playing Elden Ring or attending local city council meetings to stay updated on environmental policies. I'm single and typically active on Reddit during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a formal education in environmental engineering, which has given me a strong foundation in technical analysis and problem-solving. Over the years, I've become passionate about audio technology through self-study and community engagement. I frequently explore new audio equipment and share my insights on various forums.
